title: Senior Program Associate - IRP
description:
**Note: This opportunity is available across Mumbai, and New Delhi**
**About Us**
 WRI India, an independent knowledge organization registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development.
   

  

 Through research, analysis, and recommendations, WRI India puts ideas into action to build transformative solutions to protect the earth, promote livelihoods, and enhance human well\-being. Know more: wri\-india.org
   

  

**Program Overview For Energy**
 The objective of the WRI India energy program is to inform and guide India’s transition to cleaner energy through strong research, ground\-level implementation experience, partnerships with key stakeholders and communicating our work. The 5 pillars of the energy program focus on increasing clean energy demand, increasing clean energy supply, supporting sub\-national energy transitions, raising the issues of materials and circularity for the energy transition and ensuring equitable development through energy transitions.
   

  

**About IRP**
 Under this initiative we work with states on Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) and to support the translation of state energy\-transition priorities into implementable plans, infrastructure requirements and investment pathways. By helping states identify the system interventions needed to meet changing demand and integrate clean energy, the work strengthens their capacity to implement reliable and modern electricity infrastructure and supports the long\-term transition towards cleaner energy supply for communities.
   

  

**Job Highlight**
 We are looking for a Senior Program Associate \- IRP to support and co\-lead WRI India’s state\-level Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) work. The role will focus on modelling and simulation, scenario development, and translating analytical findings into insights that can inform electricity sector policy and regulatory decision\-making.
   

  

 The position will also drive project execution and stakeholder engagement, working closely with state electricity utilities, regulators, renewable energy agencies, partners, and other stakeholders. In addition, the role will contribute to capacity\-building initiatives on resource adequacy and IRP, develop knowledge products and research outputs, and facilitate training sessions for relevant institutions and stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring strong analytical and research capabilities, an understanding of power sector policy and regulatory processes, and the ability to translate complex analysis into actionable insights and effective stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Support and co\-lead the state\-specific IRP work of WRI India, including overseeing the modelling and simulation, designing of scenarios and interpretation of results to draw insights that can help inform regulatory and policy decision\-making at the state level, etc.
* Manage the IRP work in terms of timely project execution and ensuring completion of all deliverables.
* Communicate with various stakeholders, especially with the state electricity utilities, regulators, RE nodal agencies, donors, partners, and other state\-level agencies, for effective collaboration to ensure a comprehensive IRP process.
* Support and co\-lead the effort of developing course content for capacity building on resource adequacy and IRP\-related processes in collaboration with partner organisations.
* Be proactive in understanding the relevant policy and regulatory processes at the state and national levels, as well as in researching and pitching ideas.
* Conduct capacity\-building sessions at various research and training institutes to present the developed course material to various stakeholders.
* Participate in research projects to produce knowledge products, reports, articles and communication products.


**What You Will Need**
**Knowledge \& Skills**
* A keen interest in policy and regulatory research and strong analytical skills, supported by professional experience, preferably in the power sector. Contributions to technical papers or research reports will be a plus.
* Excellent project management skills with an ability to track, monitor and ensure compliance with timelines, milestones and due completion of project deliverables.
* Good understanding of the basic institutional framework of the Indian electricity sector with an ability to analyse, interpret and summarise relevant policy, legal and regulatory documents.
* Exposure to or familiarity with power sector modelling tools and software (e.g., PLEXOS, GridPath, PSS®E) is desirable, and a willingness to learn new tools and modelling techniques relevant to the work is crucial.
* Excellent communication skills in presenting/sharing WRI’s research findings – both orally and through op\-eds, blogs, and research publications – with a wide set of stakeholders.
* Strong ability to brainstorm and think creatively about all elements of the project in diverse group settings, especially when collaborating with partners and external agencies.
* A willingness to travel and an ability to work flexibly and cooperatively with all team members to achieve the project goals are essential.


**Qualifications And Requirements We Seek**
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Public Policy, Law or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5\-7 years of relevant experience in electricity sector policy and regulatory analysis. Exposure to open\-source energy models would be a plus.
* Fluency in English and Hindi. Any other regional language fluency will be a plus.


**Potential Salary and Benefits:** 
***INR 14,00,000 to 17,50,000 Per Annum***
 Salary shall be commensurate with experience, skills and internal parity. WRI India offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package.
   

  

**Duration:** 
 1 year as a term hire (extendable based on performance and project requirements)
   

  

**Location** 
 : Preferably Mumbai or Delhi
   

  

**Start date** 
 : As soon as possible
   

  

**List Of Documents To Be Attached**
* Cover Letter
* Resume


 Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purpose.

**Job Title:** 
 Principal Data Scientist
   

  

**Department, Level:** 
 Viewer Experiences
   

  

**Location:** 
 Onsite, Bangalore
   

  

**Work Type:** 
 Full time
   

  

**Job Summary:** 
 We believe personalization is the operating system of the customer experience—not just a recommendation engine. As a Principal Data Scientist, you will define the scientific vision and technical strategy for an AI\-native personalization platform that powers Search, Recommendations, Homepage, Ads, and Notifications for millions of users. This is a high\-impact leadership role where your work will directly influence customer engagement, retention, and Watch Time Per User (WTPU), while setting the direction for one of the industry's most advanced personalization ecosystems. If you're passionate about building AI systems at massive scale and solving complex customer problems, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.
   

  

**About the team:** 
 At JioHotstar, the Viewer Experience (VX) org is at the heart of how millions discover, engage with, and fall in love with our platform. We own the end\-to\-end user journey—from first app launch to daily habit loops—across Search, Personalization, Watch Experience, Interactivity, and more. We blend world\-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a seamless, personalized, and engaging OTT experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building immersive, intelligent, and performant user experiences that delight a billion users, join us in shaping the future of streaming.
   

  

**Reporting To:**
**Key responsibilities:**
* Define the personalization vision: Lead the evolution of JioHotstar's AI\-native personalization platform, by designing systems that continuously understand every content we carry on the platform, who the customer is, what they intend to consume, and what they are most likely to value next, enabling seamless personalization across Search, Recommendations, Homepage, Ads, and Notifications.
* Architect next\-generation AI systems: Build scalable, real\-time personalization solutions using representation learning, foundation models, sequential user modeling, multimodal intelligence, semantic retrieval, and continuously learning systems.
* Solve personalization at scale: Drive innovation in customer understanding, intent prediction, cold\-start, real\-time recommendations, exploration vs. exploitation, diversity, and low\-latency decision\-making
* Build Platforms, Not Models: Develop foundational capabilities such as unified user and content representations, experimentation frameworks, feature platforms, and real\-time inference services. Drive organizational thinking beyond optimizing isolated algorithms toward building continuously learning intelligence systems.
* Lead scientific excellence: Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Business leaders to define long\-term AI strategy
* Develop Talent \& Technical Excellence: Mentor senior data scientists, influence architectural decisions, champion AI\-native ways of working, and establish scientific rigor across experimentation, measurement, and platform development


**Skills and attributes for success:**
* Proven experience building and operating large\-scale production personalization or search systems serving millions of users
* Demonstrated success translating scientific innovation into measurable customer and business outcomes
* Deep expertise in representation learning, behavioral embeddings, and sequential user modeling for personalization.
* Strong understanding of semantic retrieval, search, ranking, and recommendation systems at scale.
* Hands\-on experience with Foundation Models, Transformers, LLMs, and multimodal AI.
* Knowledge of contextual bandits, reinforcement learning, causal inference, and long\-term optimization techniques.
* Experience building real\-time ML systems, including streaming pipelines, feature stores, vector retrieval, online inference, experimentation frameworks, and model serving.
* Strong engineering mindset with the ability to translate cutting\-edge research into scalable, production\-grade AI solutions.
* Excellent product intuition, with a focus on solving customer problems and delivering measurable business impact.
* Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous environments, solve complex problems from first principles, and influence cross\-functional teams through technical leadership


**Preferred education and experience:**
 Bachelors/Masters in Statistics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Machine Learning with 12\+ years of experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, Personalization, Search, or/and Recommendation Systems.
   

  

**About Us:**
 Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media \& entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.

**Job Description**

**Senior Principal Data Scientist**
  

  

  

 The NielsenIQ Strategic Analytics and Insights team builds and scales globally deployed analytics and AI products that power decision‑making for retailers and manufacturers worldwide. Leveraging industry‑leading data assets and modern cloud platforms, we design always‑on, production‑grade AI systems embedded directly into client‑facing and internal products.
   

  





 We are hiring a Principal Data Scientist with deep expertise in Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems. This is a senior, hands‑on technical role for an experienced AI practitioner who has designed, built, and deployed LLM‑powered systems in production, not just experimented with them.
   

  





 In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Platform teams to take ideas from concept through deployment, while influencing AI architecture, standards, and best practices across the organization.
   

  






 Lead Advanced AI \& Generative AI Solutions
   

  





* Design, develop, and deploy advanced AI/ML systems, with a strong focus on Generative AI and Agentic AI (e.g., LLM‑based reasoning, planning, tool use, and orchestration).
* Architect and implement LLM‑powered applications, including prompt engineering, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), fine‑tuning, and evaluation frameworks.
* Design agentic workflows that combine models, tools, memory, and business logic to solve complex, multi‑step analytical and decision‑making problems.
* Translate ambiguous business and product challenges into scalable AI system designs, selecting the right modeling and GenAI approaches.




 Build From Prototype to Production
   

  





* Rapidly prototype and validate new AI capabilities, then partner with Engineering to deliver secure, reliable, production‑grade systems.
* Define and uphold standards for model quality, performance, monitoring, and lifecycle management across ML and GenAI solutions.
* Ensure AI systems meet enterprise expectations for governance, explainability, robustness, and responsible AI use.




 Influence and Collaborate Across Teams
   

  





* Act as a technical leader and trusted advisor across Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Platform teams.
* Clearly communicate complex technical concepts, trade‑offs, and recommendations to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Drive initiatives end‑to‑end, aligning across multiple teams and managing dependencies in a fast‑moving environment.




 Mentor and Shape Technical Excellence
   

  





* Mentor and guide other data scientists, promoting best practices in ML, GenAI system design, and software engineering.
* Stay current with advances in LLMs, multimodal models, agent frameworks, optimization techniques, and cloud‑native AI architectures, and help translate them into practical, high‑impact solutions.


**Qualifications**


 Experience \& Expertise
   

  





* Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience building and deploying ML and AI systems in production environments.
* Recent, hands‑on experience with Generative AI and LLM‑based applications, including:
* Prompt engineering and systematic evaluation
* Retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG)
* Model fine‑tuning or adaptation techniques
* Agentic or multi‑agent system architectures
* Strong foundation in classical machine learning and statistical modeling, with good judgment about when GenAI is (and is not) the right solution.
* Experience with optimization techniques (e.g., linear or integer programming, constrained optimization) is a plus.




 Engineering \& Platform Skills
   

  





* Advanced proficiency in Python, with experience using SQL and PySpark in cloud analytics environments.
* Hands‑on experience deploying AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, GCP, or equivalent), including MLOps and LLMOps practices.
* Familiarity with Git‑based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development.




 Business Context \& Communication
   

  





* Experience working with large‑scale transactional or behavioral datasets (retail, CPG, FMCG, or similar domains is a plus).
* Excellent problem‑solving and communication skills, with the ability to operate independently at a Principal level and influence senior stakeholders.



**Why Join NielsenIQ**



* Build real, production AI systems used by global clients—not just experiments or demos.
* Shape how Generative and Agentic AI are applied responsibly at enterprise scale.
* Influence long‑term AI architecture and standards across a global analytics organization.
* Work on complex, high‑impact business problems with talented peers across data science, engineering, and product.

title: Senior Expert II Data Scientist
description:
**Summary**
 Join the Modeling \& Simulation Data Science team within the Translational Medicine, Pharmacokinetic Sciences Unit to advance data\-driven drug discovery. This role combines advanced data science with robust software engineering to transform large\-scale experimental datasets into impactful insights and scalable digital solutions supporting drug discovery and development.
   

  

 We are seeking for a talent to provide support at Biomedical Research India within Pharmacokinetic Sciences (PKS) Modeling \& Simulation, focusing on lead identification and optimization in close collaboration with Novartis colleagues in the US and Switzerland, to discover and advance innovative methods addressing areas of high unmet medical need. The PKS department handles a high volume of experimental data across ADME, PK and PD domains. This role plays a critical part in leveraging these data through advanced analytics, machine learning, and software engineering to inform decision\-making, accelerate lead optimization, and enhance reproducibility and scalability of scientific workflows.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Major accountabilities:**
* Serve as a trusted partner between Data \& Digital (D\&D) and PKS wet and dry lab teams to identify gaps and translate business needs into strategically aligned solutions within the D\&D portfolio.
* Act as a data science representative in Integrated Drug Discovery (IDD) programs, providing scientific and strategic input using experimental and computational data.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, applications, and analytical workflows.
* Develop, deploy, and maintain machine learning models to uncover structure–property relationships and support decision\-making.
* Apply statistical analysis and data mining techniques to derive insights from complex biological and chemical datasets.
* Write production\-quality, maintainable code following software engineering best practices (testing, version control, documentation).
* Collaborate across cross\-functional teams to integrate computational solutions into scientific workflows.
* Identify opportunities for automation, improved data usage, and development of in silico models and digital tools.
* Communicate findings clearly to diverse audiences and contribute to the adoption of data\-driven approaches.


**Minimum requirement**
* PhD in life sciences, computational biology, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, or a related field, and 3\-4 years (PhD) / 7\-8 overall years of relevant work experience in drug discovery within biomedical or pharmaceutical research settings.
* Strong expertise in machine learning, statistics, and data science workflows applied to drug discovery.
* Proficiency in Python and/or R with solid software engineering practices.

**Analysis:**
